name: convo_v1_chat_turn
description: One chat turn: load the previous turn's history, ask the LLM, save the new history.

inputTemplate.systemPrompt: You are a wealth advisor assistant. Be concise.

tasks.name: has_prev
tasks.description: Only load the previous execution when the caller passed its id.

load.name: load_prev
load.description: Fetch the previous turn's execution; optional, so a missing id just starts fresh.

tasks.name: build_history
tasks.description: Reuse the previous history only if it is a COMPLETED turn of this same session.

inputParameters.queryExpression: (.prev.response.body? // .prev.workflow? // .prev) as $p | (if ($p | type) == "object" and $p.status == "COMPLETED" and ($p.input.sessionId? // null) == .sessionId then ($p.output.history? // []) else [] end) as $h | {history: $h, restored: ($h | length > 0), messages: ([{"role":"system","message":.sys}] + $h + [{"role":"user","message":.msg}])}

tasks.name: chat
tasks.description: Ask the LLM, with the system prompt, the history and the new message.

tasks.name: save_history
tasks.description: Append the user message and the reply, keep the last 20 messages.
